explanation: OEIS A112521, G. McGarvey's conjecture: starting with n = 1, a(n) is the main diagonal of the array T(1,1) = 1, T(i,j) = 0 off the positive quadrant, T(n,k) = T(n,k−2) + T(n,k−1) − 2T(n−1,k−1) + T(n−1,k) + T(n−2,k). The formal a is the OEIS formula Σ (−1)^(j−1) C(2n−j−1, n−j) C(2(j−1), j−1) re-indexed by j ↦ j+1 (the dropped j = 0 term is 0), and T is the stated array. I checked a(0..9) against the DATA and a(n) = T(n,n) for 1 ≤ n ≤ 9. The statement ∀ n ≥ 1, a(n) = T(n,n) matches. Faithful.
